assets.name: button-symbols
assets.prompt: A sprite sheet EXACTLY 6 columns by 2 rows, 12 separated symbols, generous cyan gutters. Each row has these six symbols left to right: play triangle, circular restart arrow, four-square album grid, double next chevron, checkmark, movie clapperboard with play triangle. Each symbol has WHITE fill, a crisp thick colored outline and subtle hand-painted shading. TOP ROW: all outlines dark moss GREEN #527934, matching a green illustrated button outline. BOTTOM ROW: same six shapes but outlines dark PLUM #604281, matching a purple button outline. Absolutely NO lavender glow, NO sticker border, NO outer white rim, NO button backgrounds. Only simple solid white symbols with dark green or dark plum outlines. Exactly two rows.

assets.name: lucky-wheel
assets.prompt: One perfectly circular lucky reward wheel, facing straight forward, centered, filling 85% of the square. EXACTLY EIGHT EQUAL radial wedge sectors, alternating pastel lilac and warm ivory, each completely EMPTY for game overlays. First ivory sector is centered straight UP at twelve o'clock; its edges are at 11:15 and 12:45. Thin violet seams. Polished lilac double rim with eight tiny golden lamps equally spaced and small gold central hub. No icons or text inside the sectors. No pointer, no stand, no banner. Perfect rotational symmetry, painted cartoon finish.
